name: Social network
looksLike: a site where people post updates and follow each other
profiles with a feed of friends posts
a community website with sharing and reactions
definition: A website centered on people’s profiles, updates, and connections, where members share content, follow others, and respond within clear privacy and moderation rules.
goal: Help members share updates and connect safely.
audience: Members who want ongoing social interaction

sections.name: Identity and navigation
sections.purpose: Show account context and access to connections and settings.

sections.name: Share an update
sections.purpose: Provide a clear posting action and attachment options.

sections.name: Feed and interaction
sections.purpose: Present updates with authors, context, and response actions.

sections.name: Safety and preferences
sections.purpose: Make privacy, reporting, and blocking easy to find.

mustHave: Accessible controls with clear action names
avoid: Public posting without a clear audience
Engagement tricks that obscure user choices

prompts.short: Build a social site with profiles, an update feed, sharing controls, privacy settings, and reporting.
prompts.detailed: Build a social network website for members who want ongoing social interaction. Help members share updates and connect safely. Include identity and navigation, share an update, feed and interaction, safety and preferences. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Visible privacy and audience controls.
